description: Defines configuration structures and enums for PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) in 5G NR, including power control, resource allocation, and transmission schemes.

classes.name: ocudu::p0_pusch_alphaset
classes.description: Represents a set of power control parameters for PUSCH, including an ID, optional p0 value, and alpha.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_power_control
classes.description: Contains power control settings for PUSCH, including reference signals, alpha, p0, and SRI mappings.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for p0_pusch_alphaset and pusch_power_control structures.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality operator for p0_pusch_alphaset and pusch_power_control structures.
